# Implementation Readiness Checklist: Image Color Analysis CLI

**Purpose**: Validate that the feature specification is complete, clear, consistent, and ready to be turned into implementation tasks.
**Created**: 2026-08-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are input source requirements explicitly documented for file path, clipboard, and standard input? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001 to FR-004]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are the supported raster image formats (PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP) explicitly listed in the requirements? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are requirements for unsupported or misspelled color models defined, including the expected error response? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are requirements for unsupported or misspelled output formats defined, including the expected error response? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are the visual output requirements complete enough to determine when the feature is enabled and when it should fail gracefully? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 - Is "major color" defined with a clear criterion for what makes a color "major"? [Clarity, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is "standard hardware" quantified sufficiently for the 5-second performance target to be testable? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the input precedence between file path, clipboard, and standard input unambiguous and consistent across all sections? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is "human-readable text name" tied to a specific named-color list or standard so output is deterministic? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is the visual output "terminal support" criterion defined with measurable or detectable conditions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 - Are the default values for count, color model, and output format consistent across user stories, requirements, and assumptions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006 to FR-014, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK012 - Do the exit-code requirements align with the edge cases and error scenarios described in the spec? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK013 - Are the coverage percentage requirements consistent with the tolerance defined in success criteria? [Consistency, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK014 - Are clipboard error requirements consistent between "no image" and "permission denied" scenarios? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-002]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 - Are all success criteria measurable without implementation-specific knowledge? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [ ] CHK016 - Does each acceptance scenario include explicit Given/When/Then conditions that can be verified? [Measurability, Spec §User Stories]
- [ ] CHK017 - Is the "equivalent results" criterion for clipboard and standard input measurable against file-based output? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007, SC-008]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is the release artifact success criterion (binaries + checksums + install scripts) testable from a published release? [Measurability, Spec §SC-010, SC-011]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK019 - Are primary user flows (file input, clipboard input, stdin input) all covered by requirements? [Coverage, Spec §User Stories]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are alternate output scenarios (text, JSON, JSONL, YAML, visual) all covered by requirements? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK021 - Are alternate color-model scenarios (RGB, CMYK, plus optional HSL/HEX) addressed in the requirements? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are recovery paths defined when clipboard access is unavailable or fails? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 - Are corrupt/truncated image handling requirements specific about the error behavior and exit code? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are very large image handling requirements specific about limits or degradation behavior? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK025 - Are empty or blank image handling requirements specific about the expected output? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK026 - Are named-color ambiguity requirements specific about how "closest" is determined? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK027 - Are performance requirements (latency, memory budget) specified with measurable thresholds for all supported input sizes? [Non-Functional, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK028 - Are cross-platform compatibility requirements specific about which platforms and architectures are supported? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK029 - Are security/exploit-resistance requirements for untrusted image input captured in the spec or constitution? [Non-Functional, Constitution §IV]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK030 - Are all external dependencies (image decoding, CLI parsing, serialization, clipboard utilities) documented as assumptions or constraints? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK031 - Are platform-specific clipboard helper assumptions (`xclip`, `pngpaste`, Windows Clipboard API) documented? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK032 - Is the MIT License assumption documented as a project constraint and included in release requirements? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions, Clarifications]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK033 - Is the "visual on screen" output format unambiguously separate from the machine-readable formats? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-010, FR-015]
- [ ] CHK034 - Is the behavior when both `--clipboard` and a file path are provided explicitly specified? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK035 - Are there any conflicting statements about whether the default output includes numeric values? [Conflict, Spec §FR-007, User Story 1]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
